# Local front-end assets

Bundled versions captured 2026-10-17; upstream sources and hashes are listed below.
No runtime CDN script, stylesheet or font requests. IGN/OSM map tiles remain external;
map tiles can fail offline while the local map controls, parcel data and HTMX panels work.
Ordinary E-Phy / OpenStreetMap attribution links are unchanged.

## Inventory and licences

- htmx **2.0.4**, **0BSD** (not BSD-2): upstream `LICENSE` included.
- MapLibre GL JS **4.7.1**, **BSD-3-Clause**: complete upstream `LICENSE.txt` included,
  including its bundled third-party notices.
- Chart.js **4.4.1**, **MIT**: upstream `LICENSE.md` included.
- DM Sans Google Fonts **v17**, **OFL-1.1**: upstream `OFL.txt` included. Google Fonts has no
  semver pin in the original template: the immutable font URLs and hashes below pin the
  actual Chromium response. Latin and Latin-ext WOFF2 files are unchanged; `dm-sans.css`
  is that response with only the URLs replaced by relative local paths. Normal weights
  400/600/700 and the original Unicode ranges and display strategy are preserved.
- Tailwind CSS **3.4.17**, **MIT**: upstream `LICENSE` included. Replaces
  `https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17` (runtime JIT) with committed minified CSS.

The original font stylesheet URL was
`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:opsz,wght@9..40,400;9..40,600;9..40,700&display=swap`;
preconnects to `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com` were also removed.
All external template script/style/font sources are accounted for below. The two
MapLibre consumers are `fields/map.html` and `fields/_today_map.html`; Chart.js is
used by `stations/detail.html`; htmx, fonts and Tailwind load in `core/base.html`.

## Rebuild CSS

Run `scripts/build_css.sh` from any directory with Node/npm available. It invokes the
pinned `npx --yes tailwindcss@3.4.17` CLI; Node is not needed at application runtime.
Theme tokens moved unchanged from `base.html` to `tailwind.config.js`.
Content covers every template, every Python file and every first-party static JS file
(including map-generated popup classes), excluding bundled vendor JS. Decision tones,
conditional widths and border bands are complete class literals; inspection found no
partially constructed Tailwind utilities requiring a safelist. Add complete literals or
a safelist entry when introducing such a class, then rebuild and commit the CSS.

The Node-free `tests/core/test_css_coverage.py` checks literal template classes and Jinja
utility choices against the shipped stylesheets and inline styles. Structural hooks with no
style rule are explicitly listed. Extra unused utilities are accepted; runtime-composed class
names still require full literals/safelist entries. This check runs in the normal pytest gate.

The committed CSS is generated by `scripts/build_css.sh`. Rebuild it whenever template classes
change and update its digest below. Handwritten `farmcore.css` additions are separate source
changes.

Core already mounts `/static/core` through the registry. Hatch packages `src/farmcore`
including these files; Docker's existing `COPY src ./src` and non-editable install ship
these prebuilt assets without a Node build step.
